mapper.select: SELECT la.id, la.user_id, la.bank_code, b.name AS bank_name, b.logo_url AS bank_logo_url, la.account_number, la.product_name, la.is_linked FROM linkable_accounts la JOIN banks b ON la.bank_code = b.code WHERE la.user_id = #{userId} AND la.is_linked = 0

SELECT la.id, la.user_id, la.bank_code, b.name AS bank_name, b.logo_url AS bank_logo_url, la.account_number, la.product_name, la.is_linked FROM linkable_accounts la JOIN banks b ON la.bank_code = b.code WHERE la.id = #{linkableAccountId} AND la.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ba.id, ba.user_id, ba.bank_code, b.name AS bank_name, ba.account_number, ba.product_name, ba.balance, ba.is_primary, ba.is_withdrawal_agreed, ba.withdrawal_agreed_at, ba.balance_updated_at, ba.is_deleted FROM bank_accounts ba JOIN banks b ON ba.bank_code = b.code WHERE ba.user_id = #{userId} AND ba.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ba.is_primary DESC, ba.id ASC

SELECT ba.id, ba.user_id, ba.bank_code, b.name AS bank_name, ba.account_number, ba.product_name, ba.balance, ba.is_primary, ba.is_withdrawal_agreed, ba.withdrawal_agreed_at, ba.balance_updated_at, ba.is_deleted FROM bank_accounts ba JOIN banks b ON ba.bank_code = b.code WHERE ba.id = #{accountId} AND ba.user_id = #{userId} AND ba.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_accounts ( user_id, bank_code, account_number, product_name, balance, is_primary, is_withdrawal_agreed, withdrawal_agreed_at, balance_updated_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bankCode}, #{accountNumber}, #{productName}, #{balance}, #{isPrimary}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE bank_accounts SET is_primary = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_primary = 1
UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = balance - #{amount}, balance_updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{accountId} AND balance >= #{amount} AND is_deleted = 0 AND #{amount} > 0
UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance = balance + #{amount}, balance_updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{accountId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND #{amount} > 0
mapper.select: SELECT ba.id, ba.user_id, ba.bank_code, b.name AS bank_name, ba.account_number, ba.product_name, ba.balance, ba.is_primary, ba.is_withdrawal_agreed, ba.withdrawal_agreed_at, ba.balance_updated_at, ba.is_deleted FROM bank_accounts ba JOIN banks b ON ba.bank_code = b.code WHERE ba.user_id = #{userId} AND ba.is_primary = 1 AND ba.is_deleted = 0
